nodes.title: The first exchange
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: Before the island, before the legend, there was a first opponent. On a quiet shore, Arima Kihei waits. A name can be won in a moment. A way of living takes longer.

nodes.title: How will you meet him?
nodes.text: Arima rests a hand on his sword. The distance between you is still yours to choose.

choices.text: Challenge him. Let the shore remember.

nodes.title: A measured beginning
nodes.speaker: ARIMA
nodes.text: A bow is easy. Show me whether your guard has the same patience.

nodes.title: One breath
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: The wind crosses the court. Your shoulders settle. Read the cut. Match its zone. Meet the steel at the last moment, and answer while he recoils.

nodes.title: A name carried on the wind
nodes.speaker: ARIMA
nodes.text: Then earn the sound of your name. Words cannot hold a blade away.

nodes.title: The silence after steel
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: Arima falls to his knees. The exchange is over. What follows will travel farther than the sound of the final cut.

nodes.title: What will you leave behind?
nodes.text: A defeated opponent. A watching world. Your next act belongs to you.

nodes.title: The ground is not the end
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: Your footing fails. Pain stays with you, but the road does not close. You leave the court wounded. You can return carrying what this defeat has taught you.

nodes.title: Will you return?
nodes.text: The wound reduces your breath and speed. The choice to rise is still yours.

choices.text: Yes. Gather yourself, then face him again.
No. Walk on with the lesson.

nodes.title: A moment beside the water
nodes.speaker: THE ROAD
nodes.text: Rest beside the water. Let your mouth and brow soften. Hold a calm expression until the ink circle closes. A broken stroke is only an invitation to begin again.

nodes.title: A hand, not another cut
nodes.text: You leave Arima alive. A victory can become the first step toward restraint. This first chapter ends here; the road to Ganryujima is still ahead.

nodes.title: A name at a cost
nodes.text: You leave with a victory others will repeat. Whether the name is worth its price will follow you down the road. This first chapter ends here; the road to Ganryujima is still ahead.

nodes.title: The road continues
nodes.text: You carry a wound and a lesson away from the court. Defeat has changed the journey, not ended it. This first chapter ends here; the road to Ganryujima is still ahead.
